payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search on answer combined with a greedy feasibility check using a sliding window with lazy difference array.
payload.rationale: The solution binary searches the maximum possible defense level and inside uses a greedy O(n) check that maintains a sliding window of archer contributions with delayed subtractions, typical of amortized analysis.
